articles.description: A 27-year-old software engineer has sparked a debate after revealing that he has built a net worth of Rs 1 crore but is already considering retirement. The techie, who works at a “FAANG-equivalent company” and freelances, said years of working seven days a week have left him exhausted by deadlines, performance reviews and layoff fears. He wants to move to a Tier-2 or Tier-3 city and live a quieter life, but Reddit users questioned whether Rs 1 crore is enough for retirement at such a young age, with many suggesting he take a break or move to a less stressful job instead.
